hadiths.text: Rapporté par Sahl ibn Sa’d رضي الله عنه : Lorsque ce verset a été révélé : « Mangez et buvez jusqu’à ce que le fil blanc soit distinct du fil noir pour vous », celui qui voulait jeûner attachait à un pied un fil noir et à l’autre un fil blanc. Il continuait à manger et à boire jusqu’à pouvoir les distinguer à l’œil nu. Après cela, Allah a révélé les mots : « min al-fajr ». Les musulmans ont alors compris que le mot « fil » désignait la nuit et le jour

chapter.ara-name: بَاب بَيَانِ أَنَّ الدُّخُولَ فِي الصَّوْمِ يَحْصُلُ بِطُلُوعِ الْفَجْرِ وَأَنَّ لَهُ الْأَكْلَ وَغَيْرَهُ حَتَّى يَطْلُعَ الْفَجْرُ وَبَيَانِ صِفَةِ الْفَجْرِ الَّذِي تَتَعَلَّقُ بِهِ الْأَحْكَامُ مِنْ الدُّخُولِ فِي الصَّوْمِ وَدُخُولِ وَقْتِ صَلَاةِ الصُّبْحِ وَغَيْرِ ذَلِكَ
chapter.eng-name: Clarifying that fasting begins at dawn, and a person may eat and other than that until dawn begins; And clarifying the dawn which has to do with the rulings concerning the beginning of fasting and the beginning of the time for the Subh Prayer, and other than that, which is the Second Dawn, which is called the True Dawn. The First Dawn, which is the False Dawn, has nothing to do with the rulings
